scope: Forty third-middle raw equations at order h^3, exact over Q. No new gauge, no order-four equation, no carrier or formal-existence claim.

wrong_sign_bch.summand: finite nested contribution with published coefficient -1/12
wrong_sign_bch.replacement: replace the finite coefficient -1/12 of N by +1/12

shared_with_published_verifiers: literal second-middle primitives kappa, including mixed lambda z^{-1} E0^2
plane geometry: coordinates, frame, bivector, line relation, transport and Cech cover
dependencies.lambda_slice_comparison: The five supplied lambda-order-three primitives inside the kappa certificate are compared with the exported primitives. They are not recomputed.
